key_points: KCL: currents into a node = currents out
KVL: voltages around any closed loop sum to zero
Pick a sign convention and keep it
Use KCL at nodes, KVL around loops
guide.explanation: Kirchhoff's laws come from conservation of charge (KCL) and energy (KVL). Together with Ohm's law they solve any resistive circuit.
guide.example: A loop has a 9 V source and resistors dropping 4 V and V2. KVL: 9 - 4 - V2 = 0, so **V2 = 5 V**.
